title: Sebelum Pukul Sepuluh
subject: a wartel operator counts down to ten o'clock, when the night tariff starts, while a student in the booth waits with his girlfriend's number and coins, and she lets him wait until the very last minute
caption: Indonesian 1990s two-guitar band pop, driving mid-tempo upbeat pulse. Clean chorus-effect guitar arpeggios against a crunchy rhythm guitar, melodic fretted electric bass, tight acoustic drum kit with open snare backbeat, bright piano doubling the chorus. 1990s studio warmth, analog compression, glassy chorus guitar. Male vocal, clear mid tenor, earnest conversational delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 118 BPM, C major. Urgent, funny and sweet mood. No synth pads, no autotune, no rap, no EDM drop, no trap hats, no modern bright pop gloss.
lyrics:
[Intro - clean chorus guitar, piano]

[Verse 1]
Aku jaga wartel di ujung gang
Jam dinding bilang sembilan lewat lima puluh
Anak kuliah masuk bilik nomor dua
Pegang kertas kusut, nomor pacarnya

[Pre-Chorus]
Tarif malam mulai pukul sepuluh
Dia tahan jarinya, tak mau menekan

[Chorus]
Sebelum pukul sepuluh, jangan dulu
Koin tinggal tiga, napas sudah tertahan
Sebelum pukul sepuluh, tunggu aku
Satu menit lagi murah, katanya

[Verse 2]
Dia tanya, Bang, lima menit lagi, ya
Kujawab, Dik, jam tak bisa dibujuk
Jam sembilan lima lima, dia nekat
Salah pencet, ibunya yang menjawab

[Pre-Chorus]
Dia menyapa sopan, matanya melotot
Jam menunjuk sepuluh, dia tertawa

[Chorus]
Pukul sepuluh, tekan sekarang
Nada sambung, jantungnya ikut berdering
Pukul sepuluh, dia tersenyum
Suaranya turun, jadi lembut sekali

[Bridge - guitar alone]
Dia lupa koin, lupa bilik
Aku diam saja, kuhitung meteran

[Chorus]
Setelah pukul sepuluh, bicaralah
Tiga jam pun tak apa, murah saja
Setelah pukul sepuluh, aku tutup
Hanya bilik dua yang masih menyala

[Outro - piano, chorus guitar fade]
